naam: Handdoek opzij vegen met je voet – zittend
pose_en: Close-up seen from the front of his lower legs and bare feet while he sits on a chair, feet hip-width apart and flat on the floor. A small towel lies spread flat on the floor just outside his RIGHT foot. His right heel stays planted, the right forefoot is turned outward and rests on the edge of the towel. One black arrow starts at his right forefoot and points inward, toward his left foot.
eind_en: END position: same close-up front view. His right heel is still on the same spot, but the right forefoot has swept far inward so the toes point clearly toward the left foot; the towel is bunched up between both feet. The right knee has not moved.

naam: Zijwaartse uitvalspas – staand
pose_en: He stands upright, seen from the front, feet together, hands clasped in front of his chest. One black arrow starts at his right foot (viewer's left) and points sideways along the floor, away from his body.
eind_en: END position: same front view. His right foot (viewer's left) is planted a big step out to the side, the right knee bent to about 90 degrees directly above the foot, hips pushed back. The left leg is completely straight with the foot flat on the floor. Torso leans slightly forward with a straight back, hands still in front of the chest.

naam: Staan op een balansmat – twee voeten
pose_en: He stands upright, seen from the front, with both feet hip-width apart on a thick soft foam balance pad lying on the floor. Knees very slightly bent, arms relaxed and slightly away from his sides, eyes looking straight ahead. One small black curved double-headed arrow next to his ankles shows a slight wobble.
eind_en: END position: same front view. He holds exactly this balanced standing posture on the foam pad, body tall and still.

naam: Eenbeenstand – op een balanskussen
pose_en: He stands, seen from the front, on a soft foam balance cushion with his full weight on his RIGHT leg (viewer's left), right knee slightly bent. The left foot is lifted about 15 cm off the floor with the left knee bent, arms slightly out to the sides for balance. One small black curved double-headed arrow next to his right ankle shows the wobble.
eind_en: END position: same front view. He holds this single-leg stance on the cushion, pelvis level, standing knee in line above the foot.

naam: Bekken cirkelen – staand met handen op tafel
pose_en: He stands facing a table, seen from behind, knees slightly bent, torso leaning a little forward with both hands flat on the tabletop. Pelvis is centred. One black circular arrow is drawn around his hips, pointing clockwise.
eind_en: END position: same view from behind. His pelvis has shifted clearly out to the right side as part of the circle, so the right hip sticks out and the waist bends, while both hands and shoulders stay in the same place.

naam: Buitenkant heup rekken – staand met gekruiste benen
pose_en: He stands upright, seen from the front, hands on his hips. His RIGHT leg (viewer's left) is crossed behind the left leg, so the right foot stands on the floor on the outside of the left foot. One black arrow starts at his right hip and points sideways outward (toward the viewer's left).
eind_en: END position: same front view. His right hip is pushed far out to the viewer's left and his torso bends sideways to the viewer's right, forming a clear C-curve along the right side of his body. Legs still crossed, both feet flat.

naam: Kuitheffing op een verhoging – tenen op een handdoekrol
pose_en: He stands on a low step, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right), one hand on a wall in front of him. He stands only on his RIGHT leg with the knee straight; the left foot is lifted behind him. The ball of the right foot is on the edge of the step, the toes are bent upward resting on a small rolled towel, and the right heel hangs down below the step edge. One black arrow starts at his right heel and points straight up.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. He has risen as high as possible onto the ball of his right foot: the heel is far above the step level, toes still bent up on the towel roll, knee straight.

naam: Van een verhoging stappen en zacht landen
pose_en: He stands upright on top of a low sturdy box (about 25 cm high), seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right), hands on his hips. His right foot hangs just past the front edge of the box. One black curved arrow starts at his feet and points forward and down to the floor in front of the box.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. He has landed on the floor in front of the box on both feet, hips and knees bent to a half squat, heels down, chest up, hands on hips. The box is behind him.

naam: Kuitheffing met gebogen knie – op één been
pose_en: He stands on his RIGHT leg only, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right), fingertips of one hand on a wall in front of him. The right knee is bent about 30 degrees and the heel is flat on the floor; the left foot is lifted behind him. One black arrow starts at his right heel and points straight up.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. His right heel is lifted high off the floor so he stands on the ball of the foot, while the right knee is still bent the same 30 degrees.

naam: Kuit rekken – voorvoet tegen de muur
pose_en: He stands facing a wall, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). His RIGHT heel is on the floor close to the wall and the right forefoot is propped up against the wall at about 45 degrees, knee straight. The left foot stands one step behind. Both hands rest lightly on the wall, body upright. One black arrow starts at his hips and points forward toward the wall.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. His hips and chest have moved forward close to the wall, the right knee is fully straight, the right forefoot still angled up against the wall and the heel on the floor; the left heel has lifted.

naam: Kuit rekken – langzit met handdoek
pose_en: He sits on the floor, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right), back upright, RIGHT leg stretched straight out in front, left knee bent with the foot flat on the floor. A towel is looped around the ball of his right foot and he holds one end in each hand; the right foot is relaxed, toes pointing slightly away. One black arrow starts at the toes of his right foot and points back toward his body.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. He has pulled the towel so his right foot is bent far back toward his shin, toes pointing toward his face, knee still completely straight on the floor.

naam: Hiel naar je bil schuiven – langzit met band
pose_en: He sits on a mat, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right), back upright, both legs straight out in front. A strap is looped around his RIGHT foot and he holds both ends in his hands. One black arrow starts at his right heel and points along the mat toward his buttock.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. His right knee is bent deeply, pointing straight up, with the heel slid close to the buttock and the foot on the mat; he pulls the strap toward himself with both hands. The left leg remains straight.

naam: Over lage horden springen – twee benen
pose_en: He stands in a shallow squat, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right), feet hip-width apart, arms swung back, directly in front of a low hurdle (about 20 cm high). One black curved arrow starts at his feet and arcs up and forward over the hurdle.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. He has landed on both feet on the other side of the hurdle (the hurdle is now behind him), knees and hips bent in a soft landing squat, arms forward.

naam: Buitenkant bovenbeen rekken – zijlig over de bedrand
pose_en: He lies on his LEFT side along the edge of a bed, seen from behind so we look at his back, head to the viewer's left. The bottom (left) leg is bent forward for stability. The top (RIGHT) leg is straight and held horizontal in line with his body. One black arrow starts at his right foot and points straight down toward the floor.
eind_en: END position: same view from behind. His straight right leg has moved slightly backward and hangs down over the edge of the bed, the foot clearly lower than the mattress, pelvis still stacked.

naam: Kruispas zijwaarts
pose_en: He stands upright, seen from the front, feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, arms a little out to the sides. One black arrow starts at his left foot (viewer's right) and points sideways across in front of his right foot, toward the viewer's left.
eind_en: END position: same front view. His left leg has crossed in front of the right leg, the left foot planted on the floor on the outside of the right foot (to the viewer's left). Hips and chest still face the viewer.

naam: Romp opzij krommen – op handen en knieën
pose_en: He is on hands and knees on a mat, seen from directly above (top-down view), head toward the top of the image, spine straight, hands under shoulders and knees under hips. One black curved arrow starts at his head and curves toward his right hip.
eind_en: END position: same top-down view. His spine is bent sideways into a clear C-shape: head turned to look over the right shoulder toward the right hip, and the right hip swung toward the right shoulder. Hands and knees stay in place.

naam: Zijwaartse uitvalspas – glijdend met één voet
pose_en: He stands upright, seen from the front, feet hip-width apart, hands clasped in front of his chest. His LEFT foot (viewer's right) rests on a small round sliding disc on the floor. One black arrow starts at his left foot and points sideways along the floor, away from his body (toward the viewer's right).
eind_en: END position: same front view. His right leg (viewer's left) is bent to about 80 degrees at the knee with the hips pushed back, knee above the foot. The left leg is perfectly straight and has slid far out to the side on the disc, foot still flat on the disc.

naam: Loopladder – twee voeten in elk vak
pose_en: He stands at the start of a flat agility ladder lying on the floor, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right), knees slightly bent, weight on the balls of his feet, elbows bent like a runner. The ladder stretches away to the viewer's right. One black arrow starts at his front foot and points forward into the first square of the ladder.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. Both of his feet are now inside the first square of the ladder, on the balls of the feet, one knee lifting already for the next quick step, arms in opposite running positions.

naam: Lopen met krukken – deels steunen op je been
pose_en: He stands upright, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right), holding a forearm crutch in each hand, the crutch tips on the floor next to his feet, feet side by side. One black arrow starts at the tips of the crutches and points forward along the floor.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. Both crutches are planted one step in front of him and his RIGHT foot has stepped forward to between the crutch tips, lightly loaded; he leans on his hands with straight elbows, the left foot still behind with the heel starting to lift.

naam: Op je hakken lopen
pose_en: He stands upright, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right), balancing on both heels with the forefeet and toes of both feet pulled up high off the floor, arms slightly out for balance. One black arrow starts at his right foot and points forward along the floor.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. He is mid-step walking on his heels: the right heel is planted a short step ahead with the toes pulled up very high, the left heel behind, toes also up; no forefoot touches the floor.

naam: Voet voor voet lopen – over een lijn
pose_en: He stands on a straight tape line on the floor, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right), in a heel-to-toe stance: right foot directly in front of the left foot, right heel touching the left toes, arms slightly out for balance. One black arrow starts at his rear (left) foot and arcs forward over the front foot.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. His left foot has stepped through and is now placed directly in front of the right foot on the line, left heel touching the right toes, body upright.

naam: Uitvalspas met rompdraai – met stok
pose_en: He is in a deep forward lunge, seen from the front: RIGHT foot (viewer's left) forward with the knee bent 90 degrees, left knee bent and hovering just above the floor behind him. He holds a wooden stick horizontally with both hands in front of his chest, torso facing the viewer. One black curved arrow starts at the centre of the stick and points toward his right side (the viewer's left).
eind_en: END position: same front view. His legs are unchanged in the lunge, but his shoulders, chest and the stick are rotated about 60 degrees toward his right (front) leg, so we see his torso turned to the viewer's left; hips and front knee still face forward.

naam: Uitvalspas rond de klok
pose_en: He stands upright, seen from the front, feet together, hands on his hips, in the centre of a faint clock face drawn on the floor. One black arrow starts at his right foot (viewer's left) and points diagonally forward and outward, toward the 2 o'clock mark on the floor.
eind_en: END position: same front view. His right foot (viewer's left) has stepped diagonally forward and out into a lunge: right knee bent about 90 degrees above the foot, left leg extended behind with the heel lifted, torso upright, hands on hips.

naam: Uitvalspas – voorste voet op een balanskussen
pose_en: He stands upright, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right), hands on his hips, feet together. A soft foam balance cushion lies on the floor one big step in front of him. One black arrow starts at his right foot and points forward to the cushion.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. His RIGHT foot is planted flat on the centre of the balance cushion with the knee bent 90 degrees above the ankle; the left knee is bent 90 degrees and hovers just above the floor behind, left heel lifted, torso upright.

naam: Nordic hamstring – knielend met vaste voeten
pose_en: He kneels tall on a mat, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right), body in one straight vertical line from knees to head. His ankles are hooked under a low, heavy padded bar behind him. Elbows bent, open hands held in front of his chest. One black curved arrow starts at his chest and points forward and down toward the floor.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. His body, still one straight line from knees to head with no bend at the hips, has tilted forward to about 45 degrees from the floor; hands are in front of the chest, ready to catch him. Ankles still fixed under the bar.

naam: Enkel ronddraaien met je hand – zittend
pose_en: He sits on a chair, seen from the front, with his RIGHT ankle resting on top of his left knee (figure-four position), bare right foot hanging free. His right hand holds the right lower leg just above the ankle; his left hand grips the right forefoot. One black circular arrow is drawn around the right forefoot.
eind_en: END position: same front view. His left hand has turned the right forefoot far around: the toes now point clearly downward and inward compared with the start, showing an exaggerated rotation at the ankle while the lower leg stays still.

naam: Plank met been heffen
pose_en: He holds a forearm plank on a mat, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right) (head toward the viewer's right): elbows under shoulders, body in one straight line from head to heels, both feet on their toes. One black arrow starts at his right heel and points straight up.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. His straight RIGHT leg is lifted so the foot is about 20 cm off the floor, at hip height; the left toes stay on the floor and the trunk remains a straight line without sagging.

naam: Pogosprongen – op de plaats
pose_en: He stands tall, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right), hands on his hips, feet hip-width apart, heels just off the floor so his weight is on the balls of his feet, knees almost straight. One black arrow starts at his feet and points straight up.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. He is in the air about 10 cm above the floor, body straight, knees nearly straight, toes pointing down toward the floor, hands on hips.

naam: Bal tegen de muur gooien en vangen – staand
pose_en: He stands upright facing a wall about two metres away, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right), feet hip-width apart, holding a medium-sized ball with both hands in front of his chest, elbows bent. One black arrow starts at the ball and points forward toward the wall.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. Both arms are stretched forward at chest height with open hands, and the ball is in the air halfway between his hands and the wall. His feet have not moved and his body is upright.

naam: Bal stuiteren en vangen – staand
pose_en: He stands upright, seen from the front, feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medium-sized ball with both hands at waist height. One black arrow starts at the ball and points straight down to the floor.
eind_en: END position: same front view. His arms are extended downward with open hands and the ball is touching the floor just in front of his feet, about to bounce back up; his feet are still in the same place, knees slightly bent.

naam: Rennen op de plaats
pose_en: He stands in an athletic stance, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right): knees and hips slightly bent, torso leaning slightly forward, both feet on the floor, elbows bent 90 degrees. One black arrow starts at his right foot and points straight up.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. He is jogging on the spot: the RIGHT foot is lifted about 15 cm off the floor with the knee bent, the left arm swings forward and the right arm back; he stands on the ball of his left foot.

naam: Knie zijwaarts openen – staand met elastiek
pose_en: He stands in a slight squat, seen from the front, hands on his hips, with a looped resistance band around both thighs just above the knees. He stands on his left leg (viewer's right); the RIGHT foot is lifted behind him with the right knee bent 90 degrees and held next to the left knee. One black arrow starts at his right knee and points sideways outward (toward the viewer's left).
eind_en: END position: same front view. His right knee has moved far out to the side (viewer's left), the hip opened, stretching the band tight; the right knee is still bent 90 degrees. The standing leg stays slightly bent and the pelvis level.

naam: Uitvalspas achterwaarts – glijdend met één voet
pose_en: He stands upright, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right), hands on his hips, feet side by side. The ball of his LEFT foot rests on a small sliding disc on the floor. One black arrow starts at his left foot and points backward along the floor (toward the viewer's left).
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. His RIGHT knee is bent about 90 degrees above the ankle with the foot flat; his left leg has slid far back behind him on the disc, left knee slightly bent and low to the floor, torso upright.

naam: Armen strekken tegen elastiek – op één been
pose_en: He stands on his RIGHT leg (viewer's left), seen from the front, the left foot lifted slightly off the floor. A resistance band is anchored at navel height to a post at the viewer's right and runs taut, horizontally, to his hands; he holds the end with both hands pressed against his belly, elbows bent. One black arrow starts at his hands and points straight forward, toward the viewer.
eind_en: END position: same front view. Both arms are stretched straight out in front of his body at navel height, hands together holding the taut band which pulls sideways; his torso has not rotated and he still balances upright on the right leg.

naam: Opstaan uit de stoel – sterke voet verder naar voren
pose_en: He sits on the front edge of a chair, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right), arms crossed over his chest, torso leaning slightly forward. His RIGHT foot is flat on the floor directly under his knee; his left foot is placed one foot-length further forward. One black arrow starts at his hips and points diagonally up and forward.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. He stands fully upright in front of the chair, hips and knees straight, arms still crossed; the feet are in the same staggered position, right foot behind the left.

naam: Opstaan uit de stoel – met schuin omhoog reiken
pose_en: He sits upright on a chair, seen from the front, feet hip-width apart under his knees. His RIGHT arm (viewer's left) is extended forward and slightly out to the side at shoulder height, the left hand resting on his thigh. One black arrow starts at his right hand and points diagonally up and outward (to the upper left of the image).
eind_en: END position: same front view. He stands fully upright in front of the chair, RIGHT arm stretched diagonally up and out above head height, body weight shifted visibly onto his right leg, hips straight.

naam: Squatsprong met kwartdraai
pose_en: He is in a half squat, seen from the front, feet hip-width apart, knees above the toes, arms swung back behind his hips. One black curved arrow starts at his shoulders and curves upward and around toward his right side (viewer's left), indicating a jump with a quarter turn.
eind_en: END position: he has jumped and turned 90 degrees, so now we see him exactly from the side, facing the viewer's left. He has landed softly on both feet in the same half squat, hips back, arms forward for balance.

naam: Kniebuiging en op de tenen komen
pose_en: He is in a squat, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right): thighs almost parallel to the floor, hips back, back straight, heels flat on the floor, arms stretched forward. One black arrow starts at his hips and points straight up.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. He stands fully upright with hips and knees straight and has risen high onto the balls of both feet, heels far off the floor, arms down by his sides.

naam: Voeten naast elkaar staan – ogen dicht
pose_en: He stands upright, seen from the front, feet together so the ankles touch, arms relaxed by his sides, eyes closed. A sturdy table stands within reach at his side. One small black curved double-headed arrow above his head shows a slight sway.
eind_en: END position: same front view. He holds exactly this posture: feet together, eyes closed, body tall and still.

naam: Bal rollen onder je voet – staand
pose_en: He stands upright, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right), on his left leg with the knee slightly bent. The sole of his RIGHT foot rests lightly on top of a football-sized ball on the floor, directly below his hip, right knee bent; arms slightly out for balance. One black arrow starts at the ball and points forward along the floor.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. His right foot has rolled the ball about 30 cm forward, so the right leg reaches forward with the knee almost straight and the foot still on top of the ball; the standing leg and upright trunk have not moved.

naam: Sterbalans – voet aantikken rondom
pose_en: He stands on his RIGHT leg (viewer's left), seen from the front, hands on his hips, right knee slightly bent; the left foot hovers just above the floor next to the right foot. Faint lines on the floor radiate from his standing foot like a star. One black arrow starts at his left foot and points sideways along the floor, away from the standing leg (toward the viewer's right).
eind_en: END position: same front view. His right knee is bent deeper (about 45 degrees) and stays above the foot, while the left leg is stretched far out to the side with only the tips of the toes lightly touching the floor; the pelvis stays level and the trunk upright.

naam: Voorkant scheenbeen rollen – foamroller
pose_en: He supports himself on both hands on a mat, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right) (head toward the viewer's right), arms straight. His RIGHT shin rests on a foam roller placed just below the knee, on the muscle beside the shin bone, the knee bent and the foot off the floor; the left leg is stretched back on its toes. One black arrow starts at the foam roller and points along the shin toward the ankle.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. His body has shifted forward over his hands so the foam roller now lies under the lower part of the right shin, just above the ankle.

naam: Uitvalspassen lopend
pose_en: He stands upright, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right), feet together, hands on his hips. One black arrow starts at his right foot and points forward along the floor, one big step ahead.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. He is in a deep forward lunge one step further to the viewer's right: RIGHT foot forward and flat with the knee bent 90 degrees above the ankle, left knee bent 90 degrees just above the floor, left heel lifted, torso upright.

naam: Kniebuiging tegen de muur – bal tussen je knieën
pose_en: He stands with his back and buttocks flat against a wall, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right), feet about 50 cm away from the wall, knees only slightly bent, arms by his sides. A small soft ball is squeezed between his knees. One black arrow starts at his hips and points straight down along the wall.
eind_en: END position: same side view of his right side. He has slid down the wall into a wall squat: hips and knees bent 90 degrees, thighs horizontal, back flat on the wall, shins vertical, the ball still squeezed between his knees.

naam: Bekken wiegen – op handen en knieën
pose_en: He is on hands and knees on a mat, seen from behind (we look at the soles of his feet and his hips), hands under shoulders, knees under hips, pelvis centred. One black arrow starts at his hips and points sideways to the right.
eind_en: END position: same view from behind. His hips have swayed clearly to the right, so the pelvis is offset beyond the right knee and the spine curves gently; hands and knees have not moved.

naam: Zijplank met been heffen
pose_en: He holds a side plank on a mat, seen from the front (his chest faces the viewer, head toward the viewer's left): he rests on his RIGHT forearm with the elbow under the shoulder and on the side of his right foot, body in a straight diagonal line, legs straight and stacked, left hand on his hip. One black arrow starts at his top (left) ankle and points straight up.
eind_en: END position: same front view. His top (left) leg is lifted, straight, about 40 cm above the lower leg, toes pointing forward; hips still high and the body line unchanged.

naam: Zijwaarts over een bosu stappen – snel
pose_en: He stands in a slight squat, seen from the front, feet hip-width apart, elbows bent. A BOSU half-ball lies dome side up on the floor immediately to the viewer's left of his feet. One black curved arrow starts at his feet and arcs sideways over the top of the BOSU to the floor on its other side.
eind_en: END position: same front view. He has shuffled sideways across the BOSU: one foot is now on the centre of the dome and the other foot is on the floor on the far side of the BOSU (viewer's left), both knees still bent in a low athletic stance.

naam: Zijwaarts springen – twee benen
pose_en: He is in a half squat, seen from the front, standing at the viewer's right side of the image, feet hip-width apart, elbows bent and pulled back. One black curved arrow starts at his feet and arcs sideways through the air toward the viewer's left.
eind_en: END position: same front view. He has landed on both feet about one metre further to the viewer's left, in the same half squat with knees in line above the feet, arms forward for balance.
